description.value: Cactus Club Cafe is a well-known upscale-casual Canadian chain with a Nanaimo location in the Northridge Village retail area on Turner Road. The chef-driven menu spans sushi, handhelds, pasta, steaks, and desserts, backed by a full lounge, patio, happy hour, and private dining spaces. Touring cyclists will find a reliable option for a substantial sit-down meal or a pickup order after a long ride.
